steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. I couldn't find any difference between them on the two pages.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

Both listings show the same rating and review count. That may mean the reviews belong to the product and not to the seller, so they probably don't tell you how reliable either seller is.

Some things the pages don't show could still matter:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's own ratings or feedback elsewhere, if that's possible.
- **Authenticity:** Neither page says the headphones are new, genuine or authorized. Check that if it matters to you.
- **Return shipping cost:** You'd pay it on either site, so a return would cost you the same either way.

If you can't find anything else to separate them, pick either one. If you want a tiebreaker, choose the seller with the better reputation or the one whose checkout is easier for you.
